=== Entrance ===
The entrance to the Veroe event is located in each factions main city. The portal activates only during Veroe event. 

The event occurs at 3:30 P.M. and 7:30 P.M. EST on Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday. 

=== Quests ===
There is also a one-time quest which rewards 50 [[Activity Tokens]] for participating in in the Veroe Harvest Festival. 

There is also an achievement for participating which rewards 5 [[Activity Tokens]], and an achievement which rewards a [[Currencies#Priceless Coin|Priceless Coin]] for participating 5 times.
